correctness.rationale: Direct multiplication establishes a split square-zero extension whose kernel, for odd m, is the regular right module. Every idempotent fiber is exactly the +1 right-Peirce eigenspace. Fourier inversion proves the odd base is finite reduced; explicit nonsingular integer exponent matrices give the exact root count. Paired even-lift Fourier modes yield the claimed dimension formula. Fraction-free determinant calculations on eleven moduli and independent exhaustive quandle-square calculations for R2 over F5 and R6 over F7 agree. Finite tests supplement, do not replace, the symbolic infinite-family proof.
